description: One event a lifecycle machine saw, keyed by the task or run it moved; the `machine:events` entry's fields.

event_id.description: The stream's unique id for the entry; absent from a record not read off a stream.
event_id.title: Event Id

event.description: The machine's own name for the event (`WORKTREE_READY`).
event.title: Event

task.description: The task key it moved; exactly one of `task` and `run` is set.
task.title: Task

run.description: The run id it moved; exactly one of `task` and `run` is set.
run.title: Run

actor.description: Who or what fired the event: an agent, a hook, a DAG.
actor.title: Actor

time.description: When it happened, in epoch seconds; a stream carries it as text and it is read as a number.
time.title: Time

title: MachineEvent
